Illustration: an open-air concert in the afternoon. On both sides of the stage are loudspeaker towers, and an audience stands in front of them. Ever wider arcs spread out from the loudspeakers. Two listeners sit far away on the hillside on the right, where the arcs reaching them are pale.
Kaavakuva, ei mittakaavassa: pistemäinen: Schematic figure, not to scale: a point sound source on the left. Rays from it bound a cone that cuts three squares at distances r, 2r and 3r. The nearest square is one cell with an area A. At distance 2r the same cone covers four cells of the same size, that is an area 4A, and at distance 3r nine cells, that is 9A. The same power is spread over an ever larger area, so the intensity is I, I/4 and I/9; the colour of the cells becomes paler in the same proportion.
Kaavakuva: intensiteettitason asteikko p: Schematic figure: the scale of the sound intensity level as a vertical bar that darkens from bottom to top. At the bottom 0 dB, that is an intensity of 10 to the power minus 12 watts per square metre, the threshold of hearing. For every 20 decibels the intensity is a hundred times greater: 20 dB whisper, 40 dB quiet room, 60 dB conversation, 80 dB busy street, 100 dB chainsaw and at the top 120 dB, that is 1 watt per square metre, the threshold of pain. The example sounds are typical orders of magnitude.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: pistemäisen äänil: Graph to scale: the sound intensity level L in decibels of a point sound source as a function of the distance r from zero to ten metres, when the power of the source is 12.6 milliwatts. The curve falls first steeply and then gently. The points at distances 1, 2, 4 and 8 metres are 90.0, 84.0, 78.0 and 71.9 dB: every time the distance doubles, the level decreases by about 6 dB.
Kaksi pylväskaaviota mittakaavassa. Vase: Two bar charts to scale. On the left the intensities in units of 10 to the power minus 4 watts per square metre: each loudspeaker alone 1.0 and together 2.0, so the combined bar is twice as tall. On the right the same situations as sound intensity levels: each alone 80 dB and together 83 dB, so the combined bar is only slightly taller.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: kaiuttimen äänen: Graph to scale: the sound intensity level L of a loudspeaker in decibels as a function of distance r from zero to ten metres, when the loudspeaker is a point source and the sound spreads evenly in all directions. The curve first falls steeply and then gently. The marked points at the distances 2, 4 and 8 metres are 80.0, 74.0 and 68.0 dB.
